analogy.rationale: Progestogens act primarily through the progesterone receptor, so progesterone receptor agonists should share the most similar transcriptional response; cross-reactivity with related steroid receptors (mineralocorticoid, glucocorticoid, androgen) gives weaker similarity. Because these cell lines express little PGR, the overall response is expected to be weak.
